title: Upstream-checkpoint sensitivity and lexical/length baselines for the CrossEncoder component R (evaluation-only)

arms.old_benchmark_exploratory: the frozen 64 constructed answers to 8 questions (EXPLORATORY/SENSITIVITY: results of the derived model on these items were already known)
arms.x2c_confirmatory: NOT RUN in this protocol version: blocked by the human/ethics gate (X2-C); the upstream arm on X2-C would run once after the X2-C gold is frozen (needs a new tagged amendment naming the item file hash)

pair_construction: (question + ' ' + rubric reference answer).strip() as the first text and the candidate answer as the second, exactly as services/evaluator/app.py cross_encoder_verification; raw model output = sentence-transformers CrossEncoder.predict (default Sigmoid activation for one label), identical for both models; R mapping (raw-0.20)/0.70 clipped to [0,1] applies ONLY to the derived model and only for the reproduction gate

scorers.derived_ce: raw output of the derived CrossEncoder
scorers.upstream_ce: raw output of the upstream CrossEncoder
scorers.tfidf: sklearn TfidfVectorizer(lowercase=True, token_pattern=r'(?u)\b\w+\b', norm='l2'), fitted on the 64 candidate texts plus the 8 distinct reference texts (label-free); cosine(reference, candidate)
scorers.bm25: Okapi BM25 k1=1.5, b=0.75, idf=ln(1+(N-n+0.5)/(n+0.5)) with N=64 candidate documents (tokens: lowercase [a-z0-9]+); query = the unique tokens of the reference text; score of each candidate
scorers.token_overlap: |unique candidate tokens intersect unique reference tokens| / |unique reference tokens| (tokens as bm25)
scorers.length_only: number of whitespace-separated tokens of the candidate answer

labels.note: construction labels, not derived from human scores or model outputs

primary_comparison: derived_ce vs upstream_ce on the mapping-independent metrics above (raw outputs; invariant to monotone rescaling). No composite is computed for the upstream arm; no MAE-type metric is reported for the upstream arm; no mapping may be invented or fitted.
secondary_comparisons: derived_ce vs each of tfidf, bm25, token_overlap, length_only (paired differences)
stored components and the deployed composite as reference rows (derived arm only)

inference.bootstrap: two-level cluster bootstrap over the 8 questions (questions with replacement, then answers within question), B=10000, numpy default_rng(42), 95% percentile
inference.paired_differences: same bootstrap draws for every scorer pair
inference.permutation_null: 10000 within-question permutations of the human gold (numpy default_rng(43)); reports the 95th percentile of the null Spearman and a one-sided permutation p, descriptive
inference.no_multiplicity_control: all comparisons are descriptive on exploratory data

gates.G-DERIVED-REPRO: derived raw output mapped by (raw-0.20)/0.70 clipped reproduces the stored R column of paper2_case_level_results.csv within 0.002 for all 64 items (validates model loading and pair construction); the run aborts otherwise
gates.G-MODEL-HASH: derived model.safetensors sha256 equals the frozen value and the upstream file sha256 starts with 821d1aa6
gates.G-METRIC-CONTROLS: positive controls on synthetic data: a perfectly monotone score gives rho=1 and AUROC=1; a reversed score gives rho=-1; a constant score gives NaN/0.5 handling as coded
